lifecycle_steps.description: User runs command npm run dev. Vite reads configuration, bundles entry points, and starts local web server on port 5173.
Browser requests root URL. Server returns index.html. Browser parses header meta tags, sets page title, and fetches CSS styles.
Browser encounters module script main.tsx. Fetches React core files, Lucide icons, Three.js modules, and index.css stylesheet.
main.tsx executes. React DOM finds div with ID root in HTML. Mounts main App component in StrictMode.
App component runs. Sets up state variables for EditorEngine instance (starts as null) and WelcomeModal visibility (starts as true).
App renders layout: Topbar on top, viewport container in middle, Sidebar panel on right, Toolbar docked at bottom, and WelcomeModal overlay.
Viewport component mounts. Identifies canvas element in DOM. Binds keydown event listener to capture Q/W/E/R/T/Delete/Backspace/Escape shortcuts.
Viewport instantiates EditorEngine class, passing canvas reference. Engine configures WebGLRenderer, sets device pixel ratio, and turns on shadows.
Engine creates THREE.Scene. Configures dark blue background color. Sets up exponential fog to give camera view depth.
Engine instantiates THREE.PerspectiveCamera. Places camera at position (15, 12, 20) looking down toward coordinate center.
Engine adds lights: Ambient light (overall fill), directional shadow-casting sunlight with 2048px shadow map size, and blue/purple fill lights for visual styling.
Engine spawns 100x100 grid helper with low opacity lines. Spawns X (red), Y (green), Z (blue) center axes lines to mark world center.
Engine instantiates OrbitControls for camera navigation. Instantiates TransformControls for moving/rotating/scaling selected shapes. Registers drag-finish command logging callbacks.
Engine registers pointerdown on canvas. Registers pointermove and pointerup on window. Listens to resize events to resize renderer dynamically.
Engine triggers animate loop using requestAnimationFrame. Constantly updates orbit damping, updates selection boxes, and renders scene at 60 FPS.
Viewport fires onEngineReady callback with EditorEngine instance. App sets engine state. Topbar, Toolbar, and Sidebar receive engine instance.
Topbar, Toolbar, and Sidebar register listener functions on the engine for history-changed, tool-changed, selection-changed, object-modified, and scene-changed events.
WelcomeModal displays template options. User clicks on 'Tiny Castle Keep' template to populate empty space.
Engine runs TemplateManager. Spawns stone blocks, corner cylinders, conical tower roofs, and gate door. Adds meshes to scene, enables shadows, and clears history.
Engine dispatches scene-changed event. Sidebar receives list of meshes and updates the hierarchy list. WelcomeModal closes. App is up and running.
User moves mouse over keep wall. pointermove raycasts mesh. Engine creates temporary BoxHelper outline in yellow to highlight object.
User left-clicks tower. pointerdown intersects mesh. Engine sets selectedObject state. Spawns cyan BoxHelper outline. Attaches TransformControls gizmo. Sidebar updates transform fields.
User drags translate handle. Mesh moves. Sidebar values refresh in real-time. Drag release fires. TransformCommand pushes to HistoryManager stack. Undo gets enabled.

User selects Push-Pull tool, clicks wall top face, and drags up. pointermove projects displacement along Y axis. Engine scales mesh Y size, shifts position up by half delta to anchor bottom, and commits command on release.
User selects paint tool, changes color to cyber cyan, finish to metal, and clicks gate. Mesh gets updated. Color change logs to history.
User clicks 'Export 3D' button. Engine compiles custom meshes into GLTF string. Downloader prompts browser download. Confetti explosion particles burst across screen.
